qpq_ui_kind_t_title_swap = {
	scope = character
	saved_scopes = { actor recipient }
	is_shown = {
		OR = {
			AND = {

		scope:actor = { is_landed = yes }
		scope:recipient = {
			is_landed = yes
			NOT = { this = scope:actor }
		}
		exists = scope:actor.liege
		scope:actor.liege = scope:recipient.liege

			}
			AND = {

		NOT = { scope:recipient.top_liege = scope:actor.top_liege }

				exists = scope:actor.house
				scope:recipient = {
					is_landed = yes
					OR = {
						any_spouse = { house ?= scope:actor.house }
						any_close_family_member = {
							OR = {
								any_spouse = { house ?= scope:actor.house }
								betrothed.house ?= scope:actor.house
							}
						}
					}
				}
			}
		}
	}
	is_valid = {
		OR = {
			AND = {

		scope:actor = { is_landed = yes }
		scope:recipient = {
			is_landed = yes
			NOT = { this = scope:actor }
		}
		exists = scope:actor.liege
		scope:actor.liege = scope:recipient.liege

			}
			AND = {

		NOT = { scope:recipient.top_liege = scope:actor.top_liege }

				exists = scope:actor.house
				scope:recipient = {
					is_landed = yes
					OR = {
						any_spouse = { house ?= scope:actor.house }
						any_close_family_member = {
							OR = {
								any_spouse = { house ?= scope:actor.house }
								betrothed.house ?= scope:actor.house
							}
						}
					}
				}
			}
		}
	}
	effect = {
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { var:qpq_ui_t_kind = flag:title_swap } }
			qpq_ui_clear_leg_t_effect = yes
		}
		set_variable = { name = qpq_ui_t_kind value = flag:title_swap }
		qpq_ui_refresh_effect = yes
	}
}

	}
	is_valid = {
		NOT = { scope:recipient.top_liege = scope:actor.top_liege }

		scope:actor = { is_landed = yes }
		scope:recipient = {
			is_independent_ruler = yes
			is_landed = yes
		}
	}
	effect = {
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { var:qpq_ui_t_kind = flag:partition_pact } }
			qpq_ui_clear_leg_t_effect = yes
		}
		set_variable = { name = qpq_ui_t_kind value = flag:partition_pact }
		qpq_ui_refresh_effect = yes
	}
}

qpq_ui_kind_t_extradition = {
	scope = character
	saved_scopes = { actor recipient }
	is_shown = {
		OR = {
			AND = {

		scope:recipient = {
			liege ?= scope:actor
			is_landed = yes
		}

			}
			AND = {

		NOT = { scope:recipient.top_liege = scope:actor.top_liege }

		scope:actor = { is_landed = yes }
		scope:recipient = {
			is_independent_ruler = yes
			is_landed = yes
		}

			}
		}
	}
	is_valid = {
		OR = {
			AND = {

		scope:recipient = {
			liege ?= scope:actor
			is_landed = yes
		}

			}
			AND = {

		NOT = { scope:recipient.top_liege = scope:actor.top_liege }

		scope:actor = { is_landed = yes }
		scope:recipient = {
			is_independent_ruler = yes
			is_landed = yes
		}

			}
		}
	}
	effect = {
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { var:qpq_ui_t_kind = flag:extradition } }
			qpq_ui_clear_leg_t_effect = yes
		}
		set_variable = { name = qpq_ui_t_kind value = flag:extradition }
		qpq_ui_refresh_effect = yes
	}
}

		scope:recipient.religion = religion:islam_religion
	}
	is_valid = {
		NOT = { scope:recipient.top_liege = scope:actor.top_liege }

		scope:actor = { is_landed = yes }
		scope:recipient = {
			is_landed = yes
			is_independent_ruler = no
			exists = liege
		}

		scope:actor.religion = religion:islam_religion
		scope:recipient.religion = religion:islam_religion
	}
	effect = {
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { var:qpq_ui_t_kind = flag:name_in_the_khutba } }
			qpq_ui_clear_leg_t_effect = yes
		}
		set_variable = { name = qpq_ui_t_kind value = flag:name_in_the_khutba }
		qpq_ui_refresh_effect = yes
	}
}

qpq_ui_kind_t_fatwa_for_hire = {
	scope = character
	saved_scopes = { actor recipient }
	is_shown = {
		scope:recipient = {
			NOT = { this = scope:actor }
			religion = religion:islam_religion
			OR = {

				AND = {
					is_clergy = yes

				}

qpq_ui_gold_up_t_10 = {
	scope = character
	effect = {
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { has_variable = qpq_ui_t_amount } }
			set_variable = { name = qpq_ui_t_amount value = var:qpq_ui_t_fair }
		}
		change_variable = { name = qpq_ui_t_amount add = 10 }
		if = {
			limit = { var:qpq_ui_t_amount < 1 }
			set_variable = { name = qpq_ui_t_amount value = 1 }
		}
		qpq_ui_refresh_effect = yes
	}
}

qpq_ui_term_down_t_5 = {
	scope = character
	is_shown = { qpq_ui_leg_t_has_term_trigger = yes }
	is_valid = {
		exists = var:qpq_ui_t_years_shown
		var:qpq_ui_t_years_shown > 1
	}
	effect = {
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { has_variable = qpq_ui_t_years } }
			set_variable = { name = qpq_ui_t_years value = var:qpq_ui_t_years_shown }
		}
		change_variable = { name = qpq_ui_t_years add = -5 }
		clamp_variable = { name = qpq_ui_t_years min = 1 max = 20 }
		qpq_ui_refresh_effect = yes
	}
}

qpq_ui_land_toggle_t = {
	scope = character
	saved_scopes = { qpq_pick }
	effect = {
		if = {
			limit = {
				has_variable_list = qpq_ui_t_land
				is_target_in_variable_list = { name = qpq_ui_t_land target = scope:qpq_pick }
			}
			remove_list_variable = { name = qpq_ui_t_land target = scope:qpq_pick }
		}
		else = {
			add_to_variable_list = { name = qpq_ui_t_land target = scope:qpq_pick }
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				has_variable_list = qpq_ui_t_land
				variable_list_size = { name = qpq_ui_t_land value > 0 }
			}
			set_variable = qpq_ui_t_o_land
		}
		else = {
			if = {
				limit = { has_variable = qpq_ui_t_o_land }
				remove_variable = qpq_ui_t_o_land
			}
		}
		qpq_ui_refresh_effect = yes
	}
}

qpq_ui_artifact_toggle_t = {
	scope = character
	saved_scopes = { qpq_pick }
	effect = {
		if = {
			limit = {
				has_variable_list = qpq_ui_t_gift_artifact
				is_target_in_variable_list = { name = qpq_ui_t_gift_artifact target = scope:qpq_pick }
			}
			remove_list_variable = { name = qpq_ui_t_gift_artifact target = scope:qpq_pick }
		}
		else = {
			add_to_variable_list = { name = qpq_ui_t_gift_artifact target = scope:qpq_pick }
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				has_variable_list = qpq_ui_t_gift_artifact
				variable_list_size = { name = qpq_ui_t_gift_artifact value > 0 }
			}
			set_variable = qpq_ui_t_o_artifact
		}
		else = {
			if = {
				limit = { has_variable = qpq_ui_t_o_artifact }
				remove_variable = qpq_ui_t_o_artifact
			}
		}
		qpq_ui_refresh_effect = yes
	}
}

		else = {

				limit = { has_variable = qpq_ui_t_o_secret }

			}
		}

}

qpq_ui_group_t_war = {
	scope = character
	saved_scopes = { actor recipient }
	is_shown = {
		OR = {
			AND = {
				scope:recipient = {
					liege ?= scope:actor
					is_landed = yes
				}
			}
			AND = {
				scope:recipient = {
					liege ?= scope:actor
					is_landed = yes
				}
			}
			AND = {
				scope:actor = {
					liege ?= scope:recipient
					is_landed = yes
				}
			}
			AND = {
				OR = {
					AND = {

				scope:recipient = {
					liege ?= scope:actor
					is_landed = yes
				}

					}
					AND = {

				NOT = { scope:recipient.top_liege = scope:actor.top_liege }

				scope:actor = { is_landed = yes }
				scope:recipient = {
					is_independent_ruler = yes
					is_landed = yes
				}

					}
				}
			}
			AND = {
				NOT = { scope:recipient.top_liege = scope:actor.top_liege }

				scope:actor = { is_landed = yes }
				scope:recipient = {
					is_independent_ruler = yes
					is_landed = yes
				}
			}
			AND = {
				NOT = { scope:recipient.top_liege = scope:actor.top_liege }
				scope:actor = { is_landed = yes } scope:recipient = { is_landed = yes }
			}
		}
	}
}

qpq_ui_group_t_favours = {
	scope = character
	saved_scopes = { actor recipient }
	is_shown = {
		OR = {
			AND = {
				scope:recipient = {
					liege ?= scope:actor
					is_landed = yes
				}
			}
			AND = {
				scope:recipient = {
					liege ?= scope:actor
					is_landed = yes
				}
			}
			AND = {
				scope:recipient = {
					liege ?= scope:actor
					is_landed = yes
				}
				scope:recipient = { any_character_artifact = { always = yes } }
			}
			AND = {
				scope:recipient = {
					liege ?= scope:actor
					is_landed = yes
				}
				scope:recipient = { any_claim = { always = yes } }
			}
			AND = {
				scope:recipient = { NOT = { this = scope:actor } }
				scope:actor = {
					any_secret = { is_known_by = scope:recipient }
				}
			}
			AND = {
				scope:recipient = {
					liege ?= scope:actor
					is_landed = yes
				}
				scope:actor = { is_at_war = yes }
			}
		}
	}
}

qpq_ui_group_t_family = {
	scope = character
	saved_scopes = { actor recipient }
	is_shown = {
		OR = {
			AND = {
				exists = scope:actor.primary_title
				scope:actor.primary_title = { any_elector = { this = scope:recipient } }
				NOT = { scope:actor = scope:recipient }
			}
			AND = {
				scope:recipient = {
					liege ?= scope:actor
					is_landed = yes
				}
			}
			AND = {
				scope:recipient = {
					liege ?= scope:actor
					is_landed = yes
				}
			}
			AND = {
				OR = {
					AND = {

				scope:actor = { is_landed = yes }
				scope:recipient = {
					is_landed = yes
					NOT = { this = scope:actor }
				}
				exists = scope:actor.liege
				scope:actor.liege = scope:recipient.liege

					}
					AND = {

				NOT = { scope:recipient.top_liege = scope:actor.top_liege }

						exists = scope:actor.house
						scope:recipient = {
							is_landed = yes
							OR = {
								any_spouse = { house ?= scope:actor.house }
								any_close_family_member = {
									OR = {
										any_spouse = { house ?= scope:actor.house }
										betrothed.house ?= scope:actor.house
									}
								}
							}
						}
					}
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

qpq_ui_group_t_blood = {
	scope = character
	saved_scopes = { actor recipient }
	is_shown = {
		OR = {
			AND = {
				scope:recipient = {
					OR = {
						liege ?= scope:actor
						is_courtier_of = scope:actor
					}
					is_adult = yes
					NOT = { this = scope:actor }
				}
			}
			AND = {
				scope:recipient = {
					OR = {
						liege ?= scope:actor
						is_courtier_of = scope:actor
					}
					is_adult = yes
					NOT = { this = scope:actor }
				}
			}
			AND = {
				scope:recipient = {
					OR = {
						liege ?= scope:actor
						is_courtier_of = scope:actor
					}
					is_adult = yes
					NOT = { this = scope:actor }
				}
			}
			AND = {
				exists = scope:actor.liege
				scope:recipient = {
					is_adult = yes
					NOT = { this = scope:actor }
					NOT = { this = scope:actor.liege }
					OR = {
						is_courtier_of = scope:actor.liege
						is_courtier_of = scope:actor
					}
				}
			}
			AND = {
				OR = {
					AND = {

				scope:recipient = {
					liege ?= scope:actor
					is_landed = yes
				}

					}
					AND = {

				NOT = { scope:recipient.top_liege = scope:actor.top_liege }

				scope:actor = { is_landed = yes }
				scope:recipient = {
					is_independent_ruler = yes
					is_landed = yes
				}

					}
				}
			}
			AND = {
				NOT = { scope:recipient.top_liege = scope:actor.top_liege }
				scope:recipient = {
					any_held_title = { is_holy_order = yes }
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

qpq_ui_group_t_shadows = {
	scope = character
	saved_scopes = { actor recipient }
	is_shown = {
		OR = {
			AND = {
				scope:recipient = {
					liege ?= scope:actor
					is_landed = yes
				}
			}
			AND = {
				scope:recipient = {
					liege ?= scope:actor
					is_landed = yes
				}
			}
			AND = {
				scope:recipient = {
					OR = {
						liege ?= scope:actor
						is_courtier_of = scope:actor
					}
					is_adult = yes
					NOT = { this = scope:actor }
				}
			}
			AND = {
				scope:recipient = {
					liege ?= scope:actor
					is_landed = yes
				}
				scope:recipient = { any_vassal = { is_landed = yes } }
			}
			AND = {
				scope:actor = {
					OR = {
						liege ?= scope:recipient
						is_imprisoned_by = scope:recipient
					}
					any_known_secret = {
						NOT = { secret_owner = scope:actor }
						NOT = { secret_owner = scope:recipient }
						NOT = { is_known_by = scope:recipient }
					}
				}
			}
			AND = {
				scope:actor = { is_landed = yes }
				scope:recipient = {
					is_landed = yes
					NOT = { this = scope:actor }
				}
				exists = scope:actor.liege
				scope:actor.liege = scope:recipient.liege
			}
			AND = {
				scope:actor = { is_landed = yes }
				scope:recipient = {
					is_landed = yes
					NOT = { this = scope:actor }
				}
				exists = scope:actor.liege
				scope:actor.liege = scope:recipient.liege
				scope:actor = { exists = joined_faction joined_faction = { faction_target = scope:actor.liege } }
			}
			AND = {
				NOT = { scope:recipient.top_liege = scope:actor.top_liege }

				scope:recipient = {
					is_councillor = yes
					exists = liege
					is_councillor_of = scope:recipient.liege
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

				}
				scope:actor = { is_landed = yes }
			}
			AND = {
				NOT = { scope:recipient.top_liege = scope:actor.top_liege }

				scope:actor = { is_landed = yes }
				scope:recipient = {
					is_landed = yes
					is_independent_ruler = no
					exists = liege
				}
			}
			AND = {
				NOT = { scope:recipient.top_liege = scope:actor.top_liege }

				scope:actor = { is_landed = yes }
				scope:recipient = {
					is_landed = yes
					is_independent_ruler = no
					exists = liege
				}
			}
		}
	}

qpq_ui_group_t_church_favours = {
	scope = character
	saved_scopes = { actor recipient }
	is_shown = {
		OR = {
			AND = {
				scope:recipient = {
					qpq_is_head_of_faith_trigger = yes
					NOT = { this = scope:actor }
				}
				scope:actor.faith = scope:recipient.faith

				scope:recipient.faith = {
					OR = {
						qpq_faith_has_church_trigger = yes
						has_doctrine = doctrine_divorce_approval
					}
				}
			}
			AND = {
				scope:recipient = {
					qpq_is_head_of_faith_trigger = yes
					NOT = { this = scope:actor }
				}
				scope:actor.faith = scope:recipient.faith
				scope:recipient.faith = { qpq_faith_has_church_trigger = yes }
			}
			AND = {
				scope:recipient = {
					qpq_is_head_of_faith_trigger = yes
					NOT = { this = scope:actor }
				}
				scope:actor.faith = scope:recipient.faith
				scope:recipient.faith = { has_doctrine = doctrine_spiritual_head }
			}
			AND = {
				scope:recipient = {
					qpq_is_head_of_faith_trigger = yes
					NOT = { this = scope:actor }
				}
				scope:actor.faith = scope:recipient.faith
				scope:actor = { has_trait = excommunicated } scope:recipient.faith = { qpq_faith_has_church_trigger = yes }
			}
			AND = {
				has_dlc_feature = by_god_alone
				scope:recipient = {
					qpq_is_head_of_faith_trigger = yes
					NOT = { this = scope:actor }
				}
				scope:actor.faith = scope:recipient.faith

				scope:recipient.faith = { has_doctrine_parameter = has_clerical_electors }
			}
			AND = {
				scope:recipient = {
					qpq_is_head_of_faith_trigger = yes
					NOT = { this = scope:actor }
				}
				scope:actor.faith = scope:recipient.faith
				scope:recipient.faith = { has_doctrine = muhammad_succession_sunni_doctrine }
			}
			AND = {
				scope:recipient = {
					qpq_is_head_of_faith_trigger = yes
					NOT = { this = scope:actor }
				}
				scope:actor.faith = scope:recipient.faith

				scope:recipient.faith = faith:orthodox
				scope:actor = {
					is_independent_ruler = no
					top_liege = { highest_held_title_tier >= tier_empire }
				}
			}
			AND = {
				scope:recipient = {
					qpq_is_head_of_faith_trigger = yes
					NOT = { this = scope:actor }
				}
				scope:actor.faith = scope:recipient.faith

				scope:recipient.faith = faith:orthodox
				scope:actor = { highest_held_title_tier >= tier_kingdom }
			}
			AND = {
				scope:recipient = {
					NOT = { this = scope:actor }
					faith = scope:actor.faith
					OR = {
						qpq_is_head_of_faith_trigger = yes
						this = scope:actor.realm_priest
					}
				}
				scope:actor.religion = { is_in_family = rf_pagan }
			}
			AND = {
				scope:recipient = {
					NOT = { this = scope:actor }
					faith = scope:actor.faith
					OR = {
						qpq_is_head_of_faith_trigger = yes
						this = scope:actor.realm_priest
					}
				}
				scope:actor.religion = { is_in_family = rf_eastern }
			}
			AND = {
				scope:recipient = {
					NOT = { this = scope:actor }
					faith = scope:actor.faith
					OR = {
						is_clergy = yes
						government_has_flag = government_is_theocracy
					}
				}
				NOT = { exists = scope:actor.faith.religious_head }
			}
		}
	}
}

					NOT = { this = scope:actor }
				}
				scope:actor.faith = scope:recipient.faith
				scope:recipient.faith = { suitable_faith_for_any_ghw_trigger = yes }
			}
			AND = {
				scope:recipient = {
					qpq_is_head_of_faith_trigger = yes
					NOT = { this = scope:actor }
				}
				scope:actor.faith = scope:recipient.faith
				scope:recipient = { is_landed = yes highest_held_title_tier >= tier_county } scope:recipient.faith = { has_doctrine = doctrine_temporal_head }
			}
			AND = {
				has_dlc_feature = by_god_alone
				scope:recipient = {
					exists = clerical_elector_title
					NOT = { this = scope:actor }
				}
				scope:recipient.faith = { has_doctrine_parameter = has_clerical_electors }
			}
			AND = {
				has_dlc_feature = by_god_alone
				scope:recipient = {
					is_clergy = yes
					NOT = { this = scope:actor }
				}
				scope:recipient.faith = scope:actor.faith
				scope:recipient.faith = { has_doctrine_parameter = has_clerical_electors }
			}
			AND = {
				NOT = { scope:recipient.top_liege = scope:actor.top_liege }

				scope:actor = { is_landed = yes }
				scope:recipient = {
					is_landed = yes
					is_independent_ruler = no
					exists = liege
				}

				scope:actor.religion = religion:islam_religion
				scope:recipient.religion = religion:islam_religion
			}
			AND = {
				scope:recipient = {
					NOT = { this = scope:actor }
					religion = religion:islam_religion
					OR = {
						qpq_is_head_of_faith_trigger = yes
						AND = {
							is_clergy = yes
							learning >= 15
						}
					}
				}
				scope:actor.religion = religion:islam_religion
			}
			AND = {
				scope:recipient = {
					NOT = { this = scope:actor }
					faith = scope:actor.faith
					OR = {
						qpq_is_head_of_faith_trigger = yes
						AND = { is_clergy = yes learning >= 12 }
					}
				}
				scope:actor.faith = { has_doctrine = muhammad_succession_shia_doctrine }
			}
		}
	}
}

qpq_ui_offer_t_gold = {
	scope = character
	saved_scopes = { actor recipient }
	is_shown = {
		qpq_ui_leg_t_allows_gold_trigger = yes
		OR = {
			has_variable = qpq_ui_t_o_gold
			AND = {
				always = yes
			}
		}
	}
	effect = {
		if = {
			limit = { has_variable = qpq_ui_t_o_gold }
			remove_variable = qpq_ui_t_o_gold
		}
		else = {
			set_variable = qpq_ui_t_o_gold
		}
		qpq_ui_refresh_effect = yes
	}
}

qpq_ui_offer_t_office = {
	scope = character
	saved_scopes = { actor recipient }
	is_shown = {
		qpq_ui_leg_t_allows_office_trigger = yes
		OR = {
			has_variable = qpq_ui_t_o_office
			AND = {
				scope:actor = { is_landed = yes }
				scope:recipient = {
					OR = {
						liege ?= scope:actor
						is_courtier_of = scope:actor
					}
					NOT = { is_councillor_of = scope:actor }
				}
			}
		}
	}
	effect = {
		if = {
			limit = { has_variable = qpq_ui_t_o_office }
			remove_variable = qpq_ui_t_o_office
		}
		else = {
			set_variable = qpq_ui_t_o_office
		}
		qpq_ui_refresh_effect = yes
	}
}

					vassal_contract_obligation_level:fortification_rights = 0
				}
				scope:actor.culture = { has_innovation = innovation_battlements }
			}
			has_variable = qpq_ui_t_o_ct_coinage
			AND = {
				qpq_ui_leg_t_allows_ct_coinage_trigger = yes
				scope:recipient = {
					liege ?= scope:actor
					is_ruler = yes
					is_tributary = no
					OR = { government_has_flag = government_is_feudal government_has_flag = government_is_japan_feudal }
					vassal_contract_has_modifiable_obligations = yes
					subject_contract_is_blocked_from_modification = no
					vassal_contract_obligation_level:coinage_rights = 0
				}
				scope:actor.culture = { has_innovation = innovation_currency_02 }
			}
			has_variable = qpq_ui_t_o_ct_faith
			AND = {
				qpq_ui_leg_t_allows_ct_faith_trigger = yes
				scope:recipient = {
					liege ?= scope:actor
					is_ruler = yes
					is_tributary = no
					OR = { government_has_flag = government_is_feudal government_has_flag = government_is_japan_feudal government_has_flag = government_is_clan }
					vassal_contract_has_modifiable_obligations = yes
					subject_contract_is_blocked_from_modification = no
					NOT = { vassal_contract_has_flag = religiously_protected }
				}
				NOT = { scope:recipient.faith = scope:actor.faith } scope:actor = { NOT = { rite = { rite_has_tenet = tenet_tax_nonbelievers } } NOT = { faith = { has_doctrine = special_doctrine_jizya } } }
			}
			has_variable = qpq_ui_t_o_ct_tax_up
			AND = {
				qpq_ui_leg_t_allows_ct_tax_up_trigger = yes
				scope:actor = {
					liege ?= scope:recipient
					is_ruler = yes
					is_tributary = no
					OR = { government_has_flag = government_is_feudal government_has_flag = government_is_japan_feudal }
					vassal_contract_has_modifiable_obligations = yes
					subject_contract_is_blocked_from_modification = no
					vassal_contract_obligation_level:feudal_government_taxes < 4
				}
			}
			has_variable = qpq_ui_t_o_ct_levy_up
			AND = {
				qpq_ui_leg_t_allows_ct_levy_up_trigger = yes
				scope:actor = {
					liege ?= scope:recipient
					is_ruler = yes
					is_tributary = no
					OR = { government_has_flag = government_is_feudal government_has_flag = government_is_japan_feudal }
					vassal_contract_has_modifiable_obligations = yes
					subject_contract_is_blocked_from_modification = no
					vassal_contract_obligation_level:feudal_government_levies < 4
				}
			}
			has_variable = qpq_ui_t_o_restraint
			AND = {
				qpq_ui_leg_t_allows_restraint_trigger = yes
				scope:recipient = { liege ?= scope:actor }
			}
		}
	}
}

qpq_ui_extra_t_qpq_x_armed = {
	scope = character
	is_shown = {
		qpq_ui_leg_t_has_extra_qpq_x_armed_trigger = yes
	}
	effect = {
		if = {
			limit = { has_variable = qpq_ui_t_qpq_x_armed }
			remove_variable = qpq_ui_t_qpq_x_armed
		}
		else = {
			set_variable = qpq_ui_t_qpq_x_armed
		}
		qpq_ui_refresh_effect = yes
	}
}

qpq_ui_kind_i_clemency_bargain = {
	scope = character
	saved_scopes = { actor recipient }
	is_shown = {
		scope:recipient = {
			OR = {
				liege ?= scope:actor
				is_imprisoned_by = scope:actor
			}
			any_known_secret = {
				NOT = { secret_owner = scope:recipient }
				NOT = { secret_owner = scope:actor }
				NOT = { is_known_by = scope:actor }
			}
		}
	}
	is_valid = {
		scope:recipient = {
			OR = {
				liege ?= scope:actor
				is_imprisoned_by = scope:actor
			}
			any_known_secret = {
				NOT = { secret_owner = scope:recipient }
				NOT = { secret_owner = scope:actor }
				NOT = { is_known_by = scope:actor }
			}
		}
	}
	effect = {
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { var:qpq_ui_i_kind = flag:clemency_bargain } }
			qpq_ui_clear_leg_i_effect = yes
		}
		set_variable = { name = qpq_ui_i_kind value = flag:clemency_bargain }
		qpq_ui_refresh_effect = yes
	}
}

qpq_ui_kind_i_mutual_defense_league = {
	scope = character
	saved_scopes = { actor recipient }
	is_shown = {

		scope:actor = {
			is_landed = yes
			NOT = { this = scope:recipient }
		}
		exists = scope:recipient.liege
		scope:recipient.liege = scope:actor.liege

			NOT = { this = scope:recipient }

qpq_ui_kind_i_title_swap = {
	scope = character
	saved_scopes = { actor recipient }
	is_shown = {
		OR = {
			AND = {

		scope:recipient = { is_landed = yes }
		scope:actor = {
			is_landed = yes
			NOT = { this = scope:recipient }
		}
		exists = scope:recipient.liege
		scope:recipient.liege = scope:actor.liege

			}
			AND = {

		NOT = { scope:actor.top_liege = scope:recipient.top_liege }

				exists = scope:recipient.house
				scope:actor = {
					is_landed = yes
					OR = {
						any_spouse = { house ?= scope:recipient.house }
						any_close_family_member = {
							OR = {
								any_spouse = { house ?= scope:recipient.house }
								betrothed.house ?= scope:recipient.house
							}
						}
					}
				}
			}
		}
	}
	is_valid = {
		OR = {
			AND = {

		scope:recipient = { is_landed = yes }
		scope:actor = {
			is_landed = yes
			NOT = { this = scope:recipient }
		}
		exists = scope:recipient.liege
		scope:recipient.liege = scope:actor.liege

			}
			AND = {

		NOT = { scope:actor.top_liege = scope:recipient.top_liege }

				exists = scope:recipient.house
				scope:actor = {
					is_landed = yes
					OR = {
						any_spouse = { house ?= scope:recipient.house }
						any_close_family_member = {
							OR = {
								any_spouse = { house ?= scope:recipient.house }
								betrothed.house ?= scope:recipient.house
							}
						}
					}
				}
			}
		}
	}
	effect = {
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { var:qpq_ui_i_kind = flag:title_swap } }
			qpq_ui_clear_leg_i_effect = yes
		}
		set_variable = { name = qpq_ui_i_kind value = flag:title_swap }
		qpq_ui_refresh_effect = yes
	}
}

qpq_ui_kind_i_coup_pact = {
	scope = character
	saved_scopes = { actor recipient }
	is_shown = {
		exists = scope:recipient.liege
		scope:actor = {
			is_adult = yes
			NOT = { this = scope:recipient }
			NOT = { this = scope:recipient.liege }
			OR = {
				is_courtier_of = scope:recipient.liege
				is_courtier_of = scope:recipient
			}
		}
	}
	is_valid = {
		exists = scope:recipient.liege
		scope:actor = {
			is_adult = yes
			NOT = { this = scope:recipient }
			NOT = { this = scope:recipient.liege }
			OR = {
				is_courtier_of = scope:recipient.liege
				is_courtier_of = scope:recipient
			}
		}
	}

		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { var:qpq_ui_i_kind = flag:coup_pact } }
			qpq_ui_clear_leg_i_effect = yes
		}

	}
}

qpq_ui_kind_i_proxy_war = {
	scope = character
	saved_scopes = { actor recipient }
	is_shown = {
		OR = {
			AND = {

			liege ?= scope:recipient

		}

			is_landed = yes
		}

			}
		}

		scope:recipient = { is_landed = yes }
		scope:actor = {
			is_independent_ruler = yes
			is_landed = yes
		}

			}
		}
	}

	}

		scope:actor = {
			qpq_is_head_of_faith_trigger = yes
			NOT = { this = scope:recipient }
		}
		scope:recipient.faith = scope:actor.faith
		scope:actor.faith = { has_doctrine = doctrine_spiritual_head }
	}
	effect = {
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { var:qpq_ui_i_kind = flag:bought_claim } }
			qpq_ui_clear_leg_i_effect = yes
		}
		set_variable = { name = qpq_ui_i_kind value = flag:bought_claim }
		qpq_ui_refresh_effect = yes
	}
}

qpq_ui_gold_up_i_10 = {
	scope = character
	effect = {
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { has_variable = qpq_ui_i_amount } }
			set_variable = { name = qpq_ui_i_amount value = var:qpq_ui_i_fair }
		}
		change_variable = { name = qpq_ui_i_amount add = 10 }
		if = {
			limit = { var:qpq_ui_i_amount < 1 }
			set_variable = { name = qpq_ui_i_amount value = 1 }
		}
		qpq_ui_refresh_effect = yes
	}
}

qpq_ui_gold_up_i_100 = {
	scope = character
	effect = {
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { has_variable = qpq_ui_i_amount } }
			set_variable = { name = qpq_ui_i_amount value = var:qpq_ui_i_fair }
		}
		change_variable = { name = qpq_ui_i_amount add = 100 }
		if = {
			limit = { var:qpq_ui_i_amount < 1 }
			set_variable = { name = qpq_ui_i_amount value = 1 }
		}
		qpq_ui_refresh_effect = yes
	}
}

	}
}

qpq_ui_gold_down_i_10 = {
	scope = character
	effect = {
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { has_variable = qpq_ui_i_amount } }
			set_variable = { name = qpq_ui_i_amount value = var:qpq_ui_i_fair }
		}
		change_variable = { name = qpq_ui_i_amount add = -10 }
		if = {
			limit = { var:qpq_ui_i_amount < 1 }
			set_variable = { name = qpq_ui_i_amount value = 1 }
		}
		qpq_ui_refresh_effect = yes
	}
}

	scope = character
	is_shown = { qpq_ui_leg_i_has_term_trigger = yes }

		exists = var:qpq_ui_i_years_shown
		var:qpq_ui_i_years_shown > 1

			limit = { NOT = { has_variable = qpq_ui_i_years } }

		clamp_variable = { name = qpq_ui_i_years min = 1 max = 20 }
		qpq_ui_refresh_effect = yes
	}
}

qpq_ui_land_toggle_i = {
	scope = character
	saved_scopes = { qpq_pick }
	effect = {
		if = {
			limit = {
				has_variable_list = qpq_ui_i_land
				is_target_in_variable_list = { name = qpq_ui_i_land target = scope:qpq_pick }
			}
			remove_list_variable = { name = qpq_ui_i_land target = scope:qpq_pick }
		}
		else = {
			add_to_variable_list = { name = qpq_ui_i_land target = scope:qpq_pick }
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				has_variable_list = qpq_ui_i_land
				variable_list_size = { name = qpq_ui_i_land value > 0 }
			}
			set_variable = qpq_ui_i_o_land
		}
		else = {
			if = {
				limit = { has_variable = qpq_ui_i_o_land }
				remove_variable = qpq_ui_i_o_land
			}
		}
		qpq_ui_refresh_effect = yes
	}
}

qpq_ui_group_i_war = {
	scope = character
	saved_scopes = { actor recipient }
	is_shown = {
		OR = {
			AND = {
				scope:actor = {
					liege ?= scope:recipient
					is_landed = yes
				}
			}
			AND = {
				scope:actor = {
					liege ?= scope:recipient
					is_landed = yes
				}
			}
			AND = {
				scope:recipient = {
					liege ?= scope:actor
					is_landed = yes
				}
			}
			AND = {
				OR = {
					AND = {

				scope:actor = {
					liege ?= scope:recipient
					is_landed = yes
				}

					}
					AND = {

				NOT = { scope:actor.top_liege = scope:recipient.top_liege }

				scope:recipient = { is_landed = yes }
				scope:actor = {
					is_independent_ruler = yes
					is_landed = yes
				}

					}
				}
			}
			AND = {
				NOT = { scope:actor.top_liege = scope:recipient.top_liege }

				scope:recipient = { is_landed = yes }
				scope:actor = {
					is_independent_ruler = yes
					is_landed = yes
				}
			}
			AND = {
				NOT = { scope:actor.top_liege = scope:recipient.top_liege }
				scope:recipient = { is_landed = yes } scope:actor = { is_landed = yes }
			}
		}
	}
}

qpq_ui_group_i_favours = {
	scope = character
	saved_scopes = { actor recipient }
	is_shown = {
		OR = {
			AND = {
				scope:actor = {
					liege ?= scope:recipient
					is_landed = yes
				}
			}
			AND = {
				scope:actor = {
					liege ?= scope:recipient
					is_landed = yes
				}
			}
			AND = {
				scope:actor = {
					liege ?= scope:recipient
					is_landed = yes
				}
				scope:actor = { any_character_artifact = { always = yes } }
			}
			AND = {
				scope:actor = {
					liege ?= scope:recipient
					is_landed = yes
				}
				scope:actor = { any_claim = { always = yes } }
			}
			AND = {
				scope:actor = { NOT = { this = scope:recipient } }
				scope:recipient = {
					any_secret = { is_known_by = scope:actor }
				}
			}
			AND = {
				scope:actor = {
					liege ?= scope:recipient
					is_landed = yes
				}
				scope:recipient = { is_at_war = yes }
			}
		}
	}
}

qpq_ui_group_i_family = {
	scope = character
	saved_scopes = { actor recipient }
	is_shown = {
		OR = {
			AND = {
				exists = scope:recipient.primary_title
				scope:recipient.primary_title = { any_elector = { this = scope:actor } }
				NOT = { scope:recipient = scope:actor }
			}
			AND = {
				scope:actor = {
					liege ?= scope:recipient
					is_landed = yes
				}
			}
			AND = {
				scope:actor = {
					liege ?= scope:recipient
					is_landed = yes
				}
			}
			AND = {
				OR = {
					AND = {

				scope:recipient = { is_landed = yes }
				scope:actor = {
					is_landed = yes
					NOT = { this = scope:recipient }
				}
				exists = scope:recipient.liege
				scope:recipient.liege = scope:actor.liege

					}
					AND = {

				NOT = { scope:actor.top_liege = scope:recipient.top_liege }

						exists = scope:recipient.house
						scope:actor = {
							is_landed = yes
							OR = {
								any_spouse = { house ?= scope:recipient.house }
								any_close_family_member = {
									OR = {
										any_spouse = { house ?= scope:recipient.house }
										betrothed.house ?= scope:recipient.house
									}
								}
							}
						}
					}
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

qpq_ui_group_i_blood = {
	scope = character
	saved_scopes = { actor recipient }
	is_shown = {
		OR = {
			AND = {
				scope:actor = {
					OR = {
						liege ?= scope:recipient
						is_courtier_of = scope:recipient
					}
					is_adult = yes
					NOT = { this = scope:recipient }
				}
			}
			AND = {
				scope:actor = {
					OR = {
						liege ?= scope:recipient
						is_courtier_of = scope:recipient
					}
					is_adult = yes
					NOT = { this = scope:recipient }
				}
			}
			AND = {
				scope:actor = {
					OR = {
						liege ?= scope:recipient
						is_courtier_of = scope:recipient
					}
					is_adult = yes
					NOT = { this = scope:recipient }
				}
			}
			AND = {
				exists = scope:recipient.liege
				scope:actor = {
					is_adult = yes
					NOT = { this = scope:recipient }
					NOT = { this = scope:recipient.liege }
					OR = {
						is_courtier_of = scope:recipient.liege
						is_courtier_of = scope:recipient
					}
				}
			}
			AND = {
				OR = {
					AND = {

				scope:actor = {
					liege ?= scope:recipient
					is_landed = yes
				}

					}
					AND = {

				NOT = { scope:actor.top_liege = scope:recipient.top_liege }

				scope:recipient = { is_landed = yes }
				scope:actor = {
					is_independent_ruler = yes
					is_landed = yes
				}

					}
				}
			}
			AND = {
				NOT = { scope:actor.top_liege = scope:recipient.top_liege }
				scope:actor = {
					any_held_title = { is_holy_order = yes }
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

qpq_ui_group_i_shadows = {
	scope = character
	saved_scopes = { actor recipient }
	is_shown = {
		OR = {
			AND = {
				scope:actor = {
					liege ?= scope:recipient
					is_landed = yes
				}
			}
			AND = {
				scope:actor = {
					liege ?= scope:recipient
					is_landed = yes
				}
			}
			AND = {
				scope:actor = {
					OR = {
						liege ?= scope:recipient
						is_courtier_of = scope:recipient
					}
					is_adult = yes
					NOT = { this = scope:recipient }
				}
			}
			AND = {
				scope:actor = {
					liege ?= scope:recipient
					is_landed = yes
				}
				scope:actor = { any_vassal = { is_landed = yes } }
			}
			AND = {
				scope:recipient = {
					OR = {
						liege ?= scope:actor
						is_imprisoned_by = scope:actor
					}
					any_known_secret = {
						NOT = { secret_owner = scope:recipient }
						NOT = { secret_owner = scope:actor }
						NOT = { is_known_by = scope:actor }
					}
				}
			}
			AND = {
				scope:recipient = { is_landed = yes }
				scope:actor = {
					is_landed = yes
					NOT = { this = scope:recipient }
				}
				exists = scope:recipient.liege
				scope:recipient.liege = scope:actor.liege
			}
			AND = {
				scope:recipient = { is_landed = yes }
				scope:actor = {
					is_landed = yes
					NOT = { this = scope:recipient }
				}
				exists = scope:recipient.liege
				scope:recipient.liege = scope:actor.liege
				scope:recipient = { exists = joined_faction joined_faction = { faction_target = scope:recipient.liege } }
			}
			AND = {
				NOT = { scope:actor.top_liege = scope:recipient.top_liege }

				scope:actor = {
					is_councillor = yes
					exists = liege
					is_councillor_of = scope:actor.liege
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

qpq_ui_group_i_abroad = {
	scope = character
	saved_scopes = { actor recipient }
	is_shown = {
		OR = {
			AND = {
				NOT = { scope:actor.top_liege = scope:recipient.top_liege }
				scope:recipient = { is_landed = yes } scope:actor = { is_landed = yes }
			}
			AND = {
				NOT = { scope:actor.top_liege = scope:recipient.top_liege }

				scope:recipient = { is_landed = yes }
				scope:actor = {
					is_independent_ruler = yes
					is_landed = yes
				}
			}
			AND = {
				NOT = { scope:actor.top_liege = scope:recipient.top_liege }

				scope:actor = {
					exists = liege
					is_independent_ruler = no
				}
				scope:recipient = { is_at_war_with = scope:actor.liege }
			}
			AND = {
				NOT = { scope:actor.top_liege = scope:recipient.top_liege }

				scope:recipient = { is_landed = yes }
				scope:actor = {
					is_landed = yes
					is_independent_ruler = no
					exists = liege
				}
			}
			AND = {
				scope:actor = {
					is_adult = yes
					NOT = { this = scope:recipient }
					any_claim = { tier >= tier_duchy NOT = { holder ?= scope:recipient } }
				}
				scope:recipient = { is_landed = yes }
			}
			AND = {
				NOT = { scope:actor.top_liege = scope:recipient.top_liege }

				scope:recipient = { is_landed = yes }
				scope:actor = {
					is_landed = yes
					is_independent_ruler = no
					exists = liege
				}
			}
			AND = {
				NOT = { scope:actor.top_liege = scope:recipient.top_liege }

				scope:recipient = { is_landed = yes }
				scope:actor = {
					is_landed = yes
					is_independent_ruler = no
					exists = liege
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

qpq_ui_group_i_church_favours = {
	scope = character
	saved_scopes = { actor recipient }
	is_shown = {
		OR = {
			AND = {
				scope:actor = {
					qpq_is_head_of_faith_trigger = yes
					NOT = { this = scope:recipient }
				}
				scope:recipient.faith = scope:actor.faith

				scope:actor.faith = {
					OR = {
						qpq_faith_has_church_trigger = yes
						has_doctrine = doctrine_divorce_approval
					}
				}
			}
			AND = {
				scope:actor = {
					qpq_is_head_of_faith_trigger = yes
					NOT = { this = scope:recipient }
				}
				scope:recipient.faith = scope:actor.faith
				scope:actor.faith = { qpq_faith_has_church_trigger = yes }
			}
			AND = {
				scope:actor = {
					qpq_is_head_of_faith_trigger = yes
					NOT = { this = scope:recipient }
				}
				scope:recipient.faith = scope:actor.faith
				scope:actor.faith = { has_doctrine = doctrine_spiritual_head }
			}
			AND = {
				scope:actor = {
					qpq_is_head_of_faith_trigger = yes
					NOT = { this = scope:recipient }
				}
				scope:recipient.faith = scope:actor.faith
				scope:recipient = { has_trait = excommunicated } scope:actor.faith = { qpq_faith_has_church_trigger = yes }
			}
			AND = {
				has_dlc_feature = by_god_alone
				scope:actor = {
					qpq_is_head_of_faith_trigger = yes
					NOT = { this = scope:recipient }
				}
				scope:recipient.faith = scope:actor.faith

				scope:actor.faith = { has_doctrine_parameter = has_clerical_electors }
			}
			AND = {
				scope:actor = {
					qpq_is_head_of_faith_trigger = yes
					NOT = { this = scope:recipient }
				}
				scope:recipient.faith = scope:actor.faith
				scope:actor.faith = { has_doctrine = muhammad_succession_sunni_doctrine }
			}
			AND = {
				scope:actor = {
					qpq_is_head_of_faith_trigger = yes
					NOT = { this = scope:recipient }
				}
				scope:recipient.faith = scope:actor.faith

				scope:actor.faith = faith:orthodox
				scope:recipient = {
					is_independent_ruler = no
					top_liege = { highest_held_title_tier >= tier_empire }
				}
			}
			AND = {
				scope:actor = {
					qpq_is_head_of_faith_trigger = yes
					NOT = { this = scope:recipient }
				}
				scope:recipient.faith = scope:actor.faith

				scope:actor.faith = faith:orthodox
				scope:recipient = { highest_held_title_tier >= tier_kingdom }
			}
			AND = {
				scope:actor = {
					NOT = { this = scope:recipient }
					faith = scope:recipient.faith
					OR = {
						qpq_is_head_of_faith_trigger = yes
						this = scope:recipient.realm_priest
					}
				}
				scope:recipient.religion = { is_in_family = rf_pagan }
			}
			AND = {
				scope:actor = {
					NOT = { this = scope:recipient }
					faith = scope:recipient.faith
					OR = {
						qpq_is_head_of_faith_trigger = yes
						this = scope:recipient.realm_priest
					}
				}
				scope:recipient.religion = { is_in_family = rf_eastern }
			}
			AND = {
				scope:actor = {
					NOT = { this = scope:recipient }
					faith = scope:recipient.faith
					OR = {
						is_clergy = yes
						government_has_flag = government_is_theocracy
					}
				}
				NOT = { exists = scope:recipient.faith.religious_head }
			}
		}
	}
}

qpq_ui_group_i_church_weapons = {
	scope = character
	saved_scopes = { actor recipient }
	is_shown = {
		OR = {
			AND = {
				scope:actor = {
					qpq_is_head_of_faith_trigger = yes
					NOT = { this = scope:recipient }
				}
				scope:recipient.faith = scope:actor.faith
				scope:actor.faith = { qpq_faith_has_church_trigger = yes }
			}
			AND = {
				scope:actor = {
					qpq_is_head_of_faith_trigger = yes
					NOT = { this = scope:recipient }
				}
				scope:recipient.faith = scope:actor.faith
				scope:actor.faith = { suitable_faith_for_any_ghw_trigger = yes }
			}
			AND = {
				scope:actor = {
					qpq_is_head_of_faith_trigger = yes
					NOT = { this = scope:recipient }
				}
				scope:recipient.faith = scope:actor.faith
				scope:actor = { is_landed = yes highest_held_title_tier >= tier_county } scope:actor.faith = { has_doctrine = doctrine_temporal_head }
			}
			AND = {
				has_dlc_feature = by_god_alone
				scope:actor = {
					exists = clerical_elector_title
					NOT = { this = scope:recipient }
				}
				scope:actor.faith = { has_doctrine_parameter = has_clerical_electors }
			}
			AND = {
				has_dlc_feature = by_god_alone
				scope:actor = {
					is_clergy = yes
					NOT = { this = scope:recipient }
				}
				scope:actor.faith = scope:recipient.faith
				scope:actor.faith = { has_doctrine_parameter = has_clerical_electors }
			}
			AND = {
				NOT = { scope:actor.top_liege = scope:recipient.top_liege }

				scope:recipient = { is_landed = yes }
				scope:actor = {
					is_landed = yes
					is_independent_ruler = no
					exists = liege
				}

				scope:recipient.religion = religion:islam_religion
				scope:actor.religion = religion:islam_religion
			}
			AND = {
				scope:actor = {
					NOT = { this = scope:recipient }
					religion = religion:islam_religion
					OR = {
						qpq_is_head_of_faith_trigger = yes
						AND = {
							is_clergy = yes
							learning >= 15
						}
					}
				}
				scope:recipient.religion = religion:islam_religion
			}
			AND = {
				scope:actor = {
					NOT = { this = scope:recipient }
					faith = scope:recipient.faith
					OR = {
						qpq_is_head_of_faith_trigger = yes
						AND = { is_clergy = yes learning >= 12 }
					}
				}
				scope:recipient.faith = { has_doctrine = muhammad_succession_shia_doctrine }
			}
		}
	}
}

qpq_ui_group_i_tribute = {
	scope = character
	saved_scopes = { actor recipient }
	is_shown = {
		OR = {
			AND = {
				scope:actor = { is_tributary_of = scope:recipient }
			}
			AND = {
				scope:recipient = { is_tributary_of = scope:actor }
			}
			AND = {
				scope:recipient = { is_tributary_of = scope:actor }
			}
			AND = {
				scope:recipient = {
					is_landed = yes
					is_independent_ruler = yes
				}
				scope:actor = {
					is_landed = yes
					is_independent_ruler = yes
					is_tributary = no
					NOT = { this = scope:recipient }
				}
			}
			AND = {
				scope:recipient = { is_landed = yes }
				scope:actor = {
					is_tributary = yes
					exists = suzerain
					NOT = { this = scope:recipient }
					NOT = { suzerain = scope:recipient }
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

qpq_ui_offer_i_gold = {
	scope = character
	saved_scopes = { actor recipient }
	is_shown = {
		qpq_ui_leg_i_allows_gold_trigger = yes
		OR = {
			has_variable = qpq_ui_i_o_gold
			AND = {
				always = yes
			}
		}
	}
	effect = {
		if = {
			limit = { has_variable = qpq_ui_i_o_gold }
			remove_variable = qpq_ui_i_o_gold
		}
		else = {
			set_variable = qpq_ui_i_o_gold
		}
		qpq_ui_refresh_effect = yes
	}
}

					subject_contract_is_blocked_from_modification = no
					NOT = { vassal_contract_has_flag = religiously_protected }
				}
				NOT = { scope:actor.faith = scope:recipient.faith } scope:recipient = { NOT = { rite = { rite_has_tenet = tenet_tax_nonbelievers } } NOT = { faith = { has_doctrine = special_doctrine_jizya } } }
			}
		}
	}
	effect = {
		if = {
			limit = { has_variable = qpq_ui_i_o_ct_faith }
			remove_variable = qpq_ui_i_o_ct_faith
		}
		else = {
			set_variable = qpq_ui_i_o_ct_faith
		}
		qpq_ui_refresh_effect = yes
	}
}

qpq_ui_offer_i_ct_tax_up = {
	scope = character
	saved_scopes = { actor recipient }
	is_shown = {
		qpq_ui_leg_i_allows_ct_tax_up_trigger = yes
		OR = {
			has_variable = qpq_ui_i_o_ct_tax_up
			AND = {
				scope:recipient = {
					liege ?= scope:actor
					is_ruler = yes
					is_tributary = no
					OR = { government_has_flag = government_is_feudal government_has_flag = government_is_japan_feudal }
					vassal_contract_has_modifiable_obligations = yes
					subject_contract_is_blocked_from_modification = no
					vassal_contract_obligation_level:feudal_government_taxes < 4
				}
			}
		}
	}
	effect = {
		if = {
			limit = { has_variable = qpq_ui_i_o_ct_tax_up }
			remove_variable = qpq_ui_i_o_ct_tax_up
		}
		else = {
			set_variable = qpq_ui_i_o_ct_tax_up
		}

	}
}

qpq_ui_contract_goods_i = {
	scope = character
	saved_scopes = { actor recipient }
	is_shown = {
		OR = {
			has_variable = qpq_ui_i_o_ct_tax_down
			AND = {
				qpq_ui_leg_i_allows_ct_tax_down_trigger = yes
				scope:actor = {
					liege ?= scope:recipient
					is_ruler = yes
					is_tributary = no
					OR = { government_has_flag = government_is_feudal government_has_flag = government_is_japan_feudal }
					vassal_contract_has_modifiable_obligations = yes
					subject_contract_is_blocked_from_modification = no
					vassal_contract_obligation_level:feudal_government_taxes > 0
				}
			}
			has_variable = qpq_ui_i_o_ct_levy_down
			AND = {
				qpq_ui_leg_i_allows_ct_levy_down_trigger = yes
				scope:actor = {
					liege ?= scope:recipient
					is_ruler = yes
					is_tributary = no
					OR = { government_has_flag = government_is_feudal government_has_flag = government_is_japan_feudal }
					vassal_contract_has_modifiable_obligations = yes
					subject_contract_is_blocked_from_modification = no
					vassal_contract_obligation_level:feudal_government_levies > 0
				}
			}
			has_variable = qpq_ui_i_o_ct_revocation
			AND = {
				qpq_ui_leg_i_allows_ct_revocation_trigger = yes
				scope:actor = {
					liege ?= scope:recipient
					is_ruler = yes
					is_tributary = no
					OR = { government_has_flag = government_is_feudal government_has_flag = government_is_japan_feudal government_has_flag = government_is_clan }
					vassal_contract_has_modifiable_obligations = yes
					subject_contract_is_blocked_from_modification = no
					NOT = { vassal_contract_has_flag = vassal_contract_cannot_revoke_titles }
				}
				OR = { scope:actor.faith = scope:recipient.faith scope:recipient.faith = { NOT = { has_doctrine_parameter = unlock_jizya_contract } } }
			}
			has_variable = qpq_ui_i_o_ct_council
			AND = {
				qpq_ui_leg_i_allows_ct_council_trigger = yes
				scope:actor = {
					liege ?= scope:recipient
					is_ruler = yes
					is_tributary = no
					OR = { government_has_flag = government_is_feudal government_has_flag = government_is_japan_feudal government_has_flag = government_is_clan }
					vassal_contract_has_modifiable_obligations = yes
					subject_contract_is_blocked_from_modification = no
					NOT = { vassal_contract_has_flag = can_demand_council_seat }
				}
			}
			has_variable = qpq_ui_i_o_ct_war
			AND = {
				qpq_ui_leg_i_allows_ct_war_trigger = yes
				scope:actor = {
					liege ?= scope:recipient
					is_ruler = yes
					is_tributary = no
					OR = { government_has_flag = government_is_feudal government_has_flag = government_is_japan_feudal government_has_flag = government_is_clan }
					vassal_contract_has_modifiable_obligations = yes
					subject_contract_is_blocked_from_modification = no
					NOT = { vassal_contract_has_flag = vassal_contract_war_override }
				}
			}
			has_variable = qpq_ui_i_o_ct_fort
			AND = {
				qpq_ui_leg_i_allows_ct_fort_trigger = yes
				scope:actor = {
					liege ?= scope:recipient
					is_ruler = yes
					is_tributary = no
					OR = { government_has_flag = government_is_feudal government_has_flag = government_is_japan_feudal }
					vassal_contract_has_modifiable_obligations = yes
					subject_contract_is_blocked_from_modification = no
					vassal_contract_obligation_level:fortification_rights = 0
				}
				scope:recipient.culture = { has_innovation = innovation_battlements }
			}
			has_variable = qpq_ui_i_o_ct_coinage
			AND = {
				qpq_ui_leg_i_allows_ct_coinage_trigger = yes
				scope:actor = {
					liege ?= scope:recipient
					is_ruler = yes
					is_tributary = no
					OR = { government_has_flag = government_is_feudal government_has_flag = government_is_japan_feudal }
					vassal_contract_has_modifiable_obligations = yes
					subject_contract_is_blocked_from_modification = no
					vassal_contract_obligation_level:coinage_rights = 0
				}
				scope:recipient.culture = { has_innovation = innovation_currency_02 }
			}
			has_variable = qpq_ui_i_o_ct_faith
			AND = {
				qpq_ui_leg_i_allows_ct_faith_trigger = yes
				scope:actor = {
					liege ?= scope:recipient
					is_ruler = yes
					is_tributary = no
					OR = { government_has_flag = government_is_feudal government_has_flag = government_is_japan_feudal government_has_flag = government_is_clan }
					vassal_contract_has_modifiable_obligations = yes
					subject_contract_is_blocked_from_modification = no
					NOT = { vassal_contract_has_flag = religiously_protected }
				}
				NOT = { scope:actor.faith = scope:recipient.faith } scope:recipient = { NOT = { rite = { rite_has_tenet = tenet_tax_nonbelievers } } NOT = { faith = { has_doctrine = special_doctrine_jizya } } }
			}
			has_variable = qpq_ui_i_o_ct_tax_up
			AND = {
				qpq_ui_leg_i_allows_ct_tax_up_trigger = yes
				scope:recipient = {
					liege ?= scope:actor
					is_ruler = yes
					is_tributary = no
					OR = { government_has_flag = government_is_feudal government_has_flag = government_is_japan_feudal }
					vassal_contract_has_modifiable_obligations = yes
					subject_contract_is_blocked_from_modification = no
					vassal_contract_obligation_level:feudal_government_taxes < 4
				}
			}
			has_variable = qpq_ui_i_o_ct_levy_up
			AND = {
				qpq_ui_leg_i_allows_ct_levy_up_trigger = yes
				scope:recipient = {
					liege ?= scope:actor
					is_ruler = yes
					is_tributary = no
					OR = { government_has_flag = government_is_feudal government_has_flag = government_is_japan_feudal }
					vassal_contract_has_modifiable_obligations = yes
					subject_contract_is_blocked_from_modification = no
					vassal_contract_obligation_level:feudal_government_levies < 4
				}
			}
			has_variable = qpq_ui_i_o_restraint
			AND = {
				qpq_ui_leg_i_allows_restraint_trigger = yes
				scope:actor = { liege ?= scope:recipient }
			}
		}
	}
}
